notes_for_editor: County conflict is unresolved: the register, Forest Lookouts page and Maine list say Piscataquis; the 1944 state map record says Penobscot (T6 R7 WELS). The story reports both. A search summary cited a Maine database entry (circa 1942, 20-ft wood tower, T6 R7) but the database URLs returned 404, so no build date or height is used. No staffing, fire or access information appears in any source read; the brief's access 'unknown' stays unknown. Consider a Maine Forest Service or state archive inquiry on the county and on the build date.
